config.rationale: This candidate tests a simpler model family with SGD and plateau-based learning-rate adaptation, providing diversity in optimizer and architecture. Standardization remains useful given channel statistics. A larger batch and lower dropout are appropriate for a smaller network. Class weighting is retained because the training distribution is imbalanced, but label smoothing is omitted to keep the hypothesis distinct from the residual candidate.
